name: events-wait
description: Long-poll until the NEXT Unity event matches your filter, then return that event. Pick one matcher: contains (free-text log substring) or marker (exact planted-beacon name). By default it waits only for FUTURE events; set sinceEventId for retro-search or includeRecentMs to catch an event that fired just before you armed the wait. timedOut:true is a normal outcome, not an error - on timeout read result.diagnostic and optionally recover with events-check-since. Subagents must be write-capable (not read-only/Ask mode).

contains.description: Match when an event's MESSAGE contains this text (case-insensitive substring). Use for free-text Unity/console logs you do not control. Prefer ASCII-only substrings (e.g. 'Wave 2 started') over Unicode punctuation.

marker.description: Match an exact beacon NAME (a string like 'level-loaded') that you planted via the marker API; compared exactly against the event's marker field. Collision-free alternative to contains for orchestrated/QA waits. This is the marker value, not a boolean toggle.

sinceEventId.description: Only match events with eventId greater than this. Capture it from bridge-get-status (lastEventId) or a trigger result BEFORE the action, so events that fire during the trigger are not missed. Omit to wait only for future events (retro-search knob).

includeRecentMs.description: Also match events from the last N milliseconds (look-back window) for races where the event may land just before the wait arms. Keep small (e.g. 500-2000). Prefer capturing sinceEventId before the trigger when you can.

timeoutMs.description: Max milliseconds to wait before returning timedOut:true (a normal branch). Client cancellation returns early. Use longer values for subscription-style waits.

source.description: Advanced: restrict to one event origin. Defaults to any source.

type.description: Advanced: restrict to one internal event type.

level.description: Advanced: restrict by severity (e.g. Error, Warning, Log).

includeData.description: Include the event's structured data payload in the result.
